# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight lad with a round, expressionless face. He is described as an emotionless, slender-less, awkward young man.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)_

## Personality

Barney is quiet, emotionless, and has an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. He smirks and laughs softly, often unable to devise a response until the moment for it has passed. Despite his lack of chatter, he harbors a vast admiration for Nell and takes immense pride in her company.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)_

## Traits

- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- Inarticulate  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
- Quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>

## History

Barney demanded that Nell sit beside him on the front seat of his buggy while driving to the concert at Pale Sands. During the journey, he offered little chatter, smirking and laughing softly whenever Nell spoke to him. Though conversation proved difficult for him, the experience of escorting Nell filled him with immense pride.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)_

## Relationships

### Nell Harcourt

- Romantic with — Barney holds a vast admiration for Nell and takes great pride in driving her to Pale Sands.  <sub>[v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029)</sub>
